markdown: ## Watchlist - **HSBC, JPMorgan:** With StoneX, they have carried out the first live trades of fractions of physical gold bars, using them as collateral in legally binding wholesale transactions [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/newsarticle/48805/jp-morgan-hsbc-and-stonex-pilot-digital-gold-trades?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed)[Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQcFlzMFE1YnAybnhxbkVOM1I0VERWWXUybENVVVhXc0Vtakwzc0IzVzFzbHRINmZsWXE1TU9QNTk4dHZFXzhpeVJOMlNqekJpSnBaMm1hSzlVc29YU2UyNVBBYkhtaTJXSzJyRTFEQkMyTXdBUU01VU9sT05XM3ZleVZNdTEzQ3gzRU1zdksyWVlsdUs0VWlmZWVrRDBwM192TGlhU2tPa3BiVDEwSXl1b1pn?oc=5). Tokenised collateral is moving into live use, so expect banks to pitch new collateral and liquidity tools to corporates. - **JPMorgan:** Former JPMorgan executive Daniel Pinto has been appointed as an external member of the Bank of England's Financial Policy Committee [Bank of England](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news/2026/november/daniel-pinto-appointment-fpc)[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPMEdnSTIxMFgxcmNtMk05Yk4wdzdiSzFPbk9HWlE1M0RvSWlJczlaTzIyRmh5UlFwN0VSTUxCNkJZcEtQWi1RYkNOTE1aOWJTd3VFMFl3TzJtRTJYR2JnUGYtbzdtQzRpY0FVUE15RzFlU2o0bnlTUGtkYnhrSHZTNTRIZG9KRHJ5U21FZ1JQNDFVTWlrYUROZkREdlVpZFBFUWdJSGtrLWh4b3JYU2pRRHFtTFhPUQ?oc=5). This doesn't change the relationship, but it does add senior US banking experience to UK financial stability policy. ## The brief - **The Trump administration is teeing up tariff hikes on the EU, China and others** [Politico](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQNHdmanQya1ZpbmtJaGc1SHh1NFItcHdxWXlLX2VGZG9NLUlDeV9RYWRVek5GWVlxdXpfNFRmRmlLMnpBZl9fWDVmTkx4ZFd0TnlGanhsbFA1XzJ3SjM3di1wMFl0MzREQ1RYWGJ5SDAtbmVYNm01YllCS29qN0ZfenB2N05OVXoxNVJFX1oxRkV1TFIwZ2U1RA?oc=5). Higher tariffs would raise landed costs on imported components, so refresh the tariff scenarios in the 2027 plan and check where pricing clauses allow pass-through. - **Half of European industrial companies are under serious financial stress, putting about 3.7mn jobs at risk, according to McKinsey** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/c0519775-12ce-4de1-9bff-419562c028df?syn-25a6b1a6=1). Supplier and customer credit risk is rising in Europe, so review exposure to weaker counterparties and consider supply chain finance to support key suppliers. - **The ECB's Simkus says it is "prudent" to hike as inflation broadens, and Kaasik says the latest data show rates must rise further** [Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPeUR3LTdfWnVXRUZxMy1QdVQyejN5NjQzMVhvOUdiUkhlUm9TOG90NzA1MEluQS1HdFdtR29DcGMtT1o5Njl3ZkVvM1IxblM5dWNUb2hBbndwbUhXU21OQmRNdXhVdWQwU0o2eUx1WXBCN0FlUllJS0NnalgxX3V2R2JFWjgtT3pPZ1ZpWFlDa1NTY0FpVlBjNFB6SDRzbTZvSHlJMlNqb2ZUTkRpeVdQYg?oc=5)[Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOa3B3RDQ0Vk1EaXh6dXJ1SzVXb2laaGkwaXhuSFZkUFNfVHVCSkRfQ0Zza3FtYklJaFloaUI3VXNYcEZzaHByLUI2b25tNU1fb3lRSFlEc2o5ai1MUDA0VTFpR2F5R3U1cWJidFlRMGVWcjVJRVN0WVk2QjlpU3gxcmxuMXpMUXJHZkQ1M3FVYUNPenJWWlFBWFBheHowU1FCVVg2S0RHZlhvVERGbEJyc25aT2Q?oc=5). Euro rates look set to keep rising, so keep euro surplus cash on short tenors and price euro facilities on that basis. - **Banks are regaining some ground from private credit lenders, which the FT says creates a window of opportunity for borrowers** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/bf403337-6e87-4aba-a306-17d63fbf1a81?syn-25a6b1a6=1). With bank and non-bank lenders competing, it may be a good time to test pricing on any new or renewed facilities. ## Rates & FX - **The peso slide continues.** USD/MXN is 19.268, up 4.36% on the week. Mexican costs are much cheaper in dollar terms, which makes a strong case to review the peso cost hedge ratio. - **Treasuries are holding the rally, but traders are hedging against Fed hikes stalling the economy** [Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxOTks3ZzVpZ2RhN2hxV1hPSlJ2T3c2ZGZrVWtKRktucmtOR3QtaWNHQ2drajdHQS1wT3BQbTJzQnBDZmhWaTgwZU1kWUxvd0w4YUVPdGVwTlZjWnNLT2tib053VjJCTno3dVZvM1Q5SGktcUp6QVV4cVotOGd5bVRSQ1AxOHBGUjViMVVCQ05KNHRLSlpxNENRM25KYTZUYnJlUHc5bnhYUzVwdnRfNmxxdmxR?oc=5). The 2-year is 4.63% and the 10-year 4.91% (-19bp on the week). SOFR is 3.92%, €STR 2.443% and SONIA 3.9837%. - **Major currencies.** EUR/USD rose 0.22% to 1.0963 and GBP/USD rose to 1.3098. EUR/GBP is 0.8370 (+0.48% on the week). USD/JPY is 159.07 and USD/CNY 6.6645. - **US core PCE (forecast +0.3%) and preliminary GDP (forecast 3.5% q/q) are out today at 13:30 Dublin.** A hot PCE would revive hike bets and could reverse the recent fall in yields. ## Also worth knowing - **Euro-zone capitals are preparing to endorse Spain's de Cos to head the ECB, while seeking a consolation role for Knot** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/d55a0dcf-ce3d-41e0-bdc9-6cb7267f6e1d?syn-25a6b1a6=1). - **Adyen co-founder and co-CEO Pieter van der Does is stepping down after 20 years** [Payments Dive](https://www.paymentsdive.com/news/adyen-co-founder-van-der-does-step-down-uytdehaage/875648/). - **B2B payments fintech Pliant has secured more than €200m of extra debt financing capacity** [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/111768/pliant-secures-200m-in-debt-financing?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed). - **The EU is planning a €50bn tech fund to take stakes in AI and quantum computing companies** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/53d4b629-7ae4-4d63-ac37-e773b1dd3af0?syn-25a6b1a6=1). ## Worth thinking about BNP Paribas says AI-driven copper demand is "overhyped" [CNBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPdURkLVRla281OGlBZnpsT1VDc0VMblExZWtiZ20yS2NPSkRlcWZyNGNWSjNoNGJOS0N0SXd0SVZPMGNHaFczOFU1Mi1FcTY3YmFidzVVdm5nNE52NWh6UmJ6WmFSbU1WSjFFcUNMQmUyX3prYzZ0cmNrYkdiTVRNU0x4aHl0QmNMaW92UE9LaVRReTdCTGc?oc=5). If that view is right, copper demand could prove softer than many expect. Is the copper hedging strategy for 2027 too short-term to benefit if prices soften, or too long to adapt if they don't?
